name: Amplifi Companies

terms.sponsorMoicNote: Base ~6.9x gross MOIC over 8 years, with ~28.9x modelled as the upside over 10. The file carries the base. Both figures are described as modelled rather than underwritten, which is a meaningful distinction for a company whose value depends on a product that has not launched.
terms.holdNote: Base 8 years; the upside case is modelled at 10.

structure: An early position in the manager itself rather than in any one of its deals — an interval fund wrapper plus the distribution engine that feeds it. The return comes from a FEE FRANCHISE: if assets under management arrive and stay, the economics compound on the management company. Held as a Reg CF SAFE.
keyRisks: The thesis depends on a product that has not launched. The scorecard is explicit that underwriting hinges on the interval fund launching and on AUM conversion and retention.
A SAFE has no maturity and no coupon; it converts on a priced round that has to happen.
Buying the manager means concentrated exposure to one firm’s distribution, which is correlated with every other deal sourced through it.
Lowest score of the fund-and-platform set at 79/100.
modelFit: Priced on the single-deal venture table: roughly 30% of outcomes at zero, a median at about 1.0x, and the sponsor’s own multiple only in the best tenth of outcomes. For a revenue-generating consumer business that downside is drawn more harshly than the facts warrant.
source: Amplifi deal scorecard comparison tables, captured from the Ancient Crunch scorecard and the Aerolane underwrite session, and supplied by a GC member in September 2026. These are SUMMARY figures: the underlying memo for this deal has not been read, so the terms here are thinner than on a card built from offering documents.
provisional: Built from a summary table rather than the deal’s own documents. Treat the terms as indicative until the memo is read.
